<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the target molecule, gives the listed precursors (esters). The target is the aldehyde product. The template should correspond to the reduction of a carboxylic acid (or ester) to an aldehyde. We'll search the template catalog using the precursor SMILES (which contains the functional group that is broken in the forward reaction) and specify that the forward reaction breaks an aliphatic carboxylic acid and forms an aldehyde.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO", "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"], "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehydes"], "limit": 10}</action_input>
